chunks: About a pledge that a man gives as security in a salam transaction, when he pays in advance for food, goods, or animals, he said: “There is no harm in securing your wealth.”

key_terms.أَسْلَمَ: he paid in advance in a salam transaction
key_terms.الرَّهْنِ: a pledge or collateral taken as security
key_terms.تَسْتَوْثِقَ: to secure oneself or obtain assurance
key_terms.سَلَمٍ: a forward sale in which payment is made in advance

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to take collateral in a salam sale for food, goods, or animals?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling permitting the use of a pledge as security in a salam transaction. It indicates that taking measures to protect one’s property in deferred-delivery sales is permissible.
